subject: Application for Network Security Engineer | Immidiate Joiner | 3.7+ years exp
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I hope you are doing well.

I am interested in exploring opportunities for Technical Security Engineer / Network Security Engineer roles. I have 3+ years of experience in Network & Security Operations with hands-on expertise in Check Point, Palo Alto, and FortiGate Firewalls, VPN/NAT, AlgoSec (AFA & FireFlow), SmartConsole, Firewall Policy Management, and Network Security Troubleshooting.

I am currently available for immediate joining.

Please find my resume attached for your review. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss any suitable openings that align with my skills and experience.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best Regards,
